key_insight: A well-balanced WE-PINN formulation exactly preserves lake-at-rest equilibria in the shallow water equations over smooth and discontinuous beds.
engineering_relevance: Exact equilibrium preservation helps prevent spurious flow in mesh-free shallow-water simulations over uneven terrain.
method: Enforce weak space–time conservation on randomly placed, potentially overlapping control volumes without differentiating the network.
Integrate the geometric source by parts and correct local bed slopes so quadrature reproduces exact bed increments.
Use independent networks across bed discontinuities, coupled by conservation of discharge and total head.
evidence_signal: Tests report round-off residuals on four lake-at-rest configurations and relative L1 free-surface errors of 6.9×10⁻⁴–3.5×10⁻³ on seven bottom-step Riemann problems.
watch_item: Exact discrete equilibrium preservation does not guarantee rapid training convergence; reaching equilibrium to round-off required an extended training budget.
paper_title: Well-Balanced WE-PINNs for the Shallow Water Equations over Smooth and Discontinuous Bathymetries
